name: Chatterfang, Squirrel General
oracle_text:
Forestwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Forest.)
If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus that many 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens are created instead.
{B}, Sacrifice X Squirrels: Target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus that many 1/1 green Squirrel creature tokens are created instead.
{B}, Sacrifice X Squirrels: Target creature gets +X/-X until end of turn.

needs.what: a replace_token_creation addition that keeps the pending tokens and adds N copies of a listed token id, where N is the number of tokens in the event ('those tokens plus that many 1/1 green Squirrel tokens'), e.g. and_create with a per-token count flag
needs.why_existing_wont_do: and_create adds one of each listed id once per creation event (Stridehangar Automaton), so three Treasures would bring one Squirrel instead of three; token_multiplier doubles the original tokens' own ids rather than adding Squirrels; create_instead replaces the tokens

needs.what: an activated-ability sacrifice cost whose count is a variable X chosen by the activator (any number of Squirrels, including 0), with X readable by the effects as {"x": ...} for a pump of +X/-X
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the sacrifice cost's count is a fixed integer (costs.py reads int(spec['count'])); x_value derives X from a value rather than letting the player choose how many permanents to sacrifice, and discard_x/pay_life_x exist only for discard and life
